description: PracticPro is the CRM and operations platform contractors and service businesses use to run their full workflow: clients and leads, estimates, contracts with electronic signatures, invoices and payments, phone calls, SMS, email, scheduling, and custom reports. Inside ChatGPT, every part of that workflow runs in plain English. Examples: "send the Carmichael estimate for signature", "record a $5,000 deposit from Rachel Kim", "text Tony Vasquez to confirm tomorrow's install", "draft a $4,200 invoice for the kitchen demo", or "show jobs with unpaid balances over $10K". Every action executes against your live PracticPro account with your existing permissions.
